name: Copper
description: Copper is a CRM built for Google Workspace users, integrating directly with Gmail and Google Calendar to manage contacts, deals, and projects for service-based businesses.
best_for: Google Workspace users and small to mid-sized service businesses like agencies, consulting, and construction firms wanting minimal setup time.
features: Native Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive integration
Visual drag-and-drop sales pipelines with AI-powered alerts
Converts closed deals into projects for onboarding and service delivery
Automated email campaign building and personalization
Mobile app that automatically logs calls and SMS
Custom reporting for revenue projections and team activity
